    About Us

    XAG Education Solutions

    Products

    • Education solutions / resources
    • Education supplies — hardcopy, physical and electronic
    • Education learning devices, apps, programs and software
    • Education lessons for students — teaching and learning
    • Recruitment and jobs — education jobs and candidate matching
    • Camps and exchange programs — learning opportunities for students
    • Education-related learning, courses and professional development for teachers, including workshops, seminars and webinars (on- and offline)
    • Hosting education-related events, sales, networking and collaboration opportunities for market and professional development
    • Consultancy for schools and businesses in education, psychology, learning and working with children

    About our teachers

    Our lead educator brings 26 years in Education, with leadership and pedagogical instruction across all grade levels and learner ages, and a Master degree in Education (qualified). Pedagogy is based on concepts of psychology and neurology.

    Our philosophy on education, teaching and learning

    We believe effective learning combines human insight with intelligent tools: differentiated, assessment-informed practice; multi-modal instruction; and adaptive pathways that respect how students actually learn. Technology should serve the teacher and the learner — not replace professional judgement.

    Refund policy
    
  
    Clear terms for courses, digital tools and professional development.
    
  
    Digital products & subscriptions
    
  
    Subscription fees are billed in advance. You may cancel renewal at any time. Unused time in the current billing period is generally non-refundable unless required by law or stated otherwise at purchase.
    
  
    Live courses & private lessons
    
  
      
    
    • Cancellation 48+ hours before the session: full credit or refund.
      • 
    
    • Cancellation within 48 hours: session may be forfeited or credited at our discretion.
      • 
    
    • If we cancel, you receive a full refund or free reschedule.
      • 
  
    
  
    Institutional packages
    
  
    Quoted packages follow the terms in your agreement. Deposit refunds depend on work already delivered.
    
  
    How to request
    
  
    Contact us via About / Contact with your order ID. We aim to respond within 5 business days.

    Privacy policy
    
  
    How we handle personal information.
    
  
    Data we collect
    
  
    Account details, contact information, order history, recruitment materials (CVs and job posts), consultancy requests, and technical logs needed to run the service. Lesson recordings only if explicitly enabled and consented.
    
  
    Classroom & video
    
  
    Live sessions may process audio, video and display names through the classroom provider you configure (built-in console for demos; Daily, Twilio, Zoom or private Jitsi in production). Hosts should only admit expected learners and should not record without a lawful basis and notice.
    
  
    Use
    
  
    To deliver services, process payments, improve products, and communicate about your account. We do not sell personal data.
    
  
    Browser storage (this demo)
    
  
    Until a server is connected, cart, orders, session, form inbox and site setup are stored in your browser (localStorage). Clearing site data removes them. Production deployments should move this to secured databases.
    
  
    Processors
    
  
    Payment and video providers (e.g. Stripe, classroom hosts) process data under their agreements when connected.
    
  
    Your rights
    
  
    Request access, correction or deletion via Contact. Retain orders as required for accounting. You may also clear local demo data from your browser settings.

          FAQ
          
  
          Common questions about classes, payments, recruitment and this site.
          

  
          Open Fusion Analytix → choose group size → pick a course → choose a schedule slot → enter as Student or Teacher. You can add the course to the cart and pay at any time.
          
  
          Sign in with your teacher account. On Fusion step 4 or Classroom, choose Teacher (host) and click Mint host token. Students join with the room name only — no token. Production tokens come from your video provider (e.g. Daily) once configured in Dashboard → Site setup.
          
  
          Start as Teacher (host). In the participant list, use mic/camera controls per student, or Mute all. You can also spotlight or remove a participant from the host console.
          
  
          In our secure database, not just on your device. Your CV is tied to your account and shown to approved schools only after you personally approve an introduction request — your email and phone number are never made public. Schools manage their job posts and candidate pipeline under Recruitment → Manage recruitment.
          
  
          USD, GBP, CNY, EUR, JPY, THB, VND, KRW, IDR, SAR, KHR, MMK and LAK appear in the header selector for display. Live payment providers settle in the currency you configure with them (e.g. Stripe).
          
  
          Demo checkout works for now while live card/Alipay/WeChat Pay payment is being finalised. Once that's switched on, checkout will confirm your order immediately and grant class access automatically.
          
  
          Share the room name or use Copy invite after the host starts. The invite link opens Classroom as Student with the room filled in.
          
  
          Use Forgot password on the sign-in form to get a reset link by email. If you don't receive it, double-check the email address you signed up with and check your spam folder.

          Manual checklist (do these yourself later)
          
    
            
      
          • Stripe: create account → get pk_test_ / sk_test_ → put secret in server/.env → publishable key in Site setup below
            • 
      
          • API: run node server/server.js (port 4242) on your machine or host
            • 
      
          • Daily (optional): daily.co account → API key + domain in .env and Site setup
            • 
      
          • Host the HTML on Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, or your school server (HTTPS)
            • 
      
          • Domain + email: point DNS; set real contact/support address
            • 
      
          • Teacher accounts: replace demo sign-in with real auth before paid classes
            • 
      
          • Legal: review Terms, Privacy, Refunds with a professional if needed
            • 
      
          • Go live Stripe: switch to pk_live_ / sk_live_ and add webhook for entitlements
            •

          Attendance
          
    
          
      Every confirmed enrolment gets its full lesson list generated automatically.
      Click a lesson number to cycle scheduled → attended → absent → scheduled.
      A parent can also self-report an absence from their own dashboard. Site
      policy: no refunds and no course extension for a missed lesson.
    
          
    
          
    
          
    
  
          
  
          
    
          Student intelligence — teacher panel
          
    
          
      Per-student progress notes, ratings and a combined timeline (attendance +
      feedback). Today this is used from the admin console; the moment a
      second teacher is set up as a signed-in account linked in "Teachers &
      revenue share" below, the same write access opens up to them for their
      own classes (already enforced in the database, not just this screen) —
      nothing about a student's other teachers or families is ever shown.
    
          
    
          
    
          
    
  
          
  
          
    
          English level test — results
          
    
          
      Every completed placement test, newest first. Nothing here can be
      spoofed by the student's browser — scoring happens server-side.
    
          
    
          
    
          
    
  
          
  
          
    
          English level test — question bank
          
    
          
      Add, unpublish or delete questions. Unpublishing keeps a question out
      of future tests without touching results already scored from it.
      "Listening" questions are written dialogue transcripts for now — no
      audio pipeline is built yet.

      reject overlapping classes for the same teacher), qualification-gated,
      and with the revenue split already calculating. The split is not tied
      to real payouts yet — that only matters once real payment keys are in
      and a second teacher is actually earning.

          English level test
          
  
          A short, free placement test — vocabulary, reading, listening and grammar — starting from the basics to find your level.
          

  
          
    
          Please sign in to take the test — your result is saved to your account.
          
  
          

  
          
    
          Before you start
          
    
            
      
          • About 20 questions, roughly 15 minutes.
            • 
      
          • Questions start easy and get harder across four skills: vocabulary, reading, listening, grammar.
            • 
      
          • The "listening" section plays through your browser's built-in text-to-speech (tap "🔊 Play audio") — a synthesized voice, not a professional recording, but real audio, not just text. The transcript stays visible either way, and if your browser can't play audio you can read it instead.
            • 
      
          • You'll get a CEFR level (A1–C1) and an approximate Lexile-style band. This is a placement guide, not a certified exam.
            • 
      
          • You can only see your own results; there's one attempt in progress at a time.
            •
